prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Match Your Pet Personality", "Select traits and hear your pet respond in real time before adopting.", "Personality Matrix", "Listen to Voice"]
1: ["Choose Desktop Landing Zone", "Pick where your desktop pet should first appear when setup completes.", "Confirm Landing Zone"]
2: ["Your Official Adoption Registry", "Name your companion first to issue your official desktop pet certificate."]
3: ["Desktop Pet Command Sandbox", "Try out keyboard shortcuts and desktop tray controls right here before finishing setup.", "Test System Tray Hide/Show"]
4: ["Assembling Desktop Pet Engine", "We are preparing high-FPS desktop animation models and audio assets."]
5: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Experience", "Select Instant Preset (Ready in 30s) or Custom Studio Pet (Unique AI Design).", "Instant: 30 Seconds", "Custom: AI Generated"]
6: ["Protect Your Desktop Pet Account", "Sign in to secure your pet state across app restarts and system reboots.", "100% Pet Reset Protection Guarantee", "Your pet progress and memory are saved permanently to your cloud account."]
7: ["Photo Quality Checklist for Best Pet Results", "Upload high-lighting, clear frontal photos to prevent rendering glitches."]
8: ["Desktop Pet Ready to Play!", "Your companion is now active on your screen. Use these quick shortcuts anytime.", "Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+P (Show/Hide)"]
9: ["Building Pet Assets in Background", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will sound a chime and notify your desktop when your pet is ready.", "Test Readiness Chime"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information by requesting photos of the user
